name: cd-stack/mock-app
description: Mock Composer project used to exercise the project-9 build/test/deploy pipeline. Structured so the same docker/nginx and docker/apache configs also work unmodified against a real Laravel app - swap this app/ directory for one with an artisan file and the server configs don't change.

scripts.lint: php -l public/index.php && find src tests -name '*.php' -exec php -l {} \;
